skill.name: web-build-deploy
skill.description: Guide for building and deploying React web applications with Vercel, Netlify, Docker, GitHub Actions, and environment configuration.
skill.summary: Build and deploy React applications with practical hosting, CI/CD, Docker, and environment setup guidance.
skill.author: CJHarmath

security_audit.summary: The audit found no prompt injection or malicious data exfiltration. Most static alerts are false positives caused by Markdown code fences, sample URLs, fixed-path dynamic imports, and normal framework environment examples. Two findings are confirmed because the Docker Compose sample uses weak hardcoded database credentials that users may copy.

remediation.issue: Hardcoded weak database credentials in the Docker Compose example.
remediation.suggestion: Replace user:pass and POSTGRES_PASSWORD=pass with placeholder variables, and state that production values must come from a secret store or uncommitted environment file.

remediation.issue: Deployment commands can install CLIs, authenticate providers, and publish production resources.
remediation.suggestion: Add a consent note that agents should ask before installing global tools, logging in to providers, or running production deployment commands.

content.value_statement: React deployment work spans hosting, CI, containers, and environment setup. This skill provides concise patterns for Vercel, Netlify, Docker, GitHub Actions, and runtime configuration.
actual_capabilities: Provides Vercel and Netlify deployment commands and configuration examples.
Shows Dockerfile, nginx, and Docker Compose patterns for serving a React SPA.
Defines GitHub Actions workflows for build, test, preview, and production deployment.
Explains Vite and Next.js environment variable usage for client and server settings.
Covers build analysis, code splitting, caching, health checks, and Sentry setup.
limitations: Focuses on React, Vite, and Next.js frontend deployment patterns.
Examples require project-specific provider accounts, secrets, domains, and build commands.
Does not replace a production security review or infrastructure architecture review.
Does not verify deployments unless the agent runs project commands with user permission.

use_cases.title: Launch a Frontend App
use_cases.description: Prepare a React application for Vercel or Netlify with build settings, redirects, headers, and preview deployments.

use_cases.title: Containerize a Web Client
use_cases.description: Create Docker and nginx deployment patterns for a static React build with SPA routing and cache headers.

use_cases.title: Standardize Release Automation
use_cases.description: Build GitHub Actions workflows that install dependencies, run tests, build assets, and deploy after merge.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a Hosting Path
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my React project and recommend whether Vercel, Netlify, or Docker is the best first deployment path. Explain the required setup steps.

prompt_templates.title: Configure Environment Variables
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me organize environment variables for my Vite or Next.js app. Separate public client values from server-only secrets and note provider setup steps.

prompt_templates.title: Create CI Deployment Flow
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a GitHub Actions deployment workflow for my React app. Include dependency install, tests, build, preview deployment, and production deployment gates.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Production Readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my web deployment plan for production readiness. Check headers, caching, Docker image size, health checks, monitoring, secrets, and rollback risks.

output_examples.input: Plan a Vercel deployment for a Vite React app.
output: Confirm the build command and output directory.
Set public API configuration in the hosting dashboard.
Enable preview deployments for pull requests.
Promote production only after tests and build checks pass.

output_examples.input: Prepare a Docker deployment checklist for a React SPA.
output: Use a multi-stage build to keep the runtime image small.
Serve the compiled app with nginx and SPA fallback routing.
Add cache headers for static assets and basic security headers.
Use unique secrets from environment management, not sample passwords.

output_examples.input: Improve production monitoring for a deployed React app.
output_examples.output: Expected guidance includes a health endpoint, error tracking setup, deployment checks, and a short validation checklist for release owners.

best_practices: Confirm provider authentication, billing, and project ownership before running deployment commands.
Keep secrets in provider secret stores or uncommitted environment files, never in repository examples.
Run tests and a local production build before promoting any deployment to production.
anti_patterns: Do not copy sample database credentials into shared or production environments.
Do not expose server-only secrets through public client environment variable prefixes.
Do not deploy to production from an unreviewed branch or failing build pipeline.

faq.question: Does this skill deploy the app automatically?
faq.answer: It provides deployment guidance and commands. An agent should ask before installing tools, logging in, or deploying resources.

faq.question: Which React build tools are covered?
faq.answer: The guidance focuses on Vite and Next.js patterns, with general React deployment advice for static builds.

faq.question: Can it help with Docker hosting?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes multi-stage build, nginx serving, SPA fallback, and Docker Compose guidance.

faq.question: Does it cover CI/CD?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes GitHub Actions examples for dependency installation, testing, building, previews, and production deployment.

faq.question: How should secrets be handled?
faq.answer: Use provider secret stores or uncommitted environment files. Replace all sample credentials with unique values.

faq.question: Is this enough for production security?
faq.answer: No. It includes basic headers and checks, but production systems need a separate security and infrastructure review.
